sources.content: The rookspan-cache image packages Rookspan, an in-memory key value cache. It is built on gcr.io/distroless/cc-debian12 and runs as the non-root user with user ID 65532. Clients connect on port 7711, and Prometheus metrics are served on port 9122 at /metrics. The image has no shell. The entrypoint is /rookspan with the argument --listen 0.0.0.0:7711. Snapshots are written to /data, so mount a volume there to keep data across restarts. The image is published for amd64 and arm64.

Configuration. ROOKSPAN_MAX_MEMORY sets the memory limit and defaults to 512mb. ROOKSPAN_EVICTION picks the eviction policy; it defaults to lru, and the other accepted value is lfu. ROOKSPAN_SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL sets seconds between snapshots and defaults to 300; a value of 0 turns snapshots off. ROOKSPAN_PASSWORD has no default, and when it is unset any client may connect without a password. The health check opens a TCP connection to port 7711 every 10 seconds.

claims.text: Setting ROOKSPAN_SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL to 0 turns Rookspan snapshots off.
The rookspan-cache image includes a shell.
Rookspan serves Prometheus metrics on port 9122.
